CGMusicalComposition

Algorithmic Concert Band Engine, Precision Vector Score Engraving, and Spatialized Concert Hall DSP Synthesizer. Orchestrated by John Daniel Dondlinger.

Civic Band Tradition: Tracing roots to 1870s lumber boom civic brass musicians crossing the Wisconsin River between Centralia and Grand Rapids, Frank Bliss's Bliss Band (1905), and Emil Lambert's Twin City Consolidated Band (1915). Dedicated to the musicians, conductors, and community of the Wisconsin Rapids City Band (501(c)(3) nonprofit).

Moonlight Sonata (Beethoven Op. 27 No. 2)
Key: C# minor | Adagio sostenuto (♩ = 54) | 60 Bars | Full Concert Band
Beethoven's sublime Adagio sostenuto authentically scored for 15-voice symphonic concert band. Features hypnotic legato woodwind triplets, noble singing French Horn and Flute leads, profound low brass organ pedal points, and subtle concert percussion.

Moonlight Samba (Beethoven Op. 27 No. 2)
Key: C# minor | Adagio con Samba e Bossa (♩ = 88) | 60 Bars | Full Band + Samba Battery
Beethoven's hypnotic Moonlight Sonata recast into an authentic Brazilian Samba and Bossa groove. Features solitary woodwind triplets (mm. 1-16), heavy Samba battery drop at m. 17 (Surdo, Caixa, Cowbell/Agogo, Cabasa), soaring French Horn lead medley, and pure acoustic resolution (mm. 49-60).

Still D.R.E. (Concert Band Edition)

West Coast G-Funk anthem translated to full symphonic wind band. Piano/mallet staccato chords, heavy tuba/bass trombone 808 pocket, and soaring trumpet brass hits.
